title.zh: 滴定曲线 · 终点附近 pH 的“悬崖”
title.en: Titration Curves · The pH Cliff Near the End Point

desc.zh: 往酸里一滴滴加碱：pH 先缓慢爬升，在等当点附近陡然跳升；指示剂变色要对准这个跳升。
desc.en: Add base to acid drop by drop: pH creeps up, then leaps near the equivalence point; the indicator must change colour right on that leap.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
